acceptance_criteria:
Focused verification of two disputed findings; see verification field.

TWO DISPUTED FINDINGS FROM PRIOR REVIEW ROUNDS — verify each against the evidence below and
report CONTRADICTED-BY-EVIDENCE or UPHELD per finding, with the specific evidence you relied on.

FINDING A (repeated 3x): "The no-hardcoded-secrets constraint update is absent from the diff."
The entire constraints.md hunk is the diff field of THIS packet. It changes exactly the
no-hardcoded-secrets check to 'node scripts/check-hardcoded-secrets.mjs' and rewrites its note.
If the hunk is present in the diff field, Finding A is contradicted.

FINDING B (repeated 3x): "The unavailable delivery-cadence documentation omits the required
carried-payload marker 'one referenced asset is absent'."
Evidence — skills/carried-payload.test.mjs mechanics (paraphrased from the actual test source):
  declaresUnavailable(text)  = text.includes('UNAVAILABLE IN THIS PROJECT')
  documentsAbsentAsset(text) = text.includes('one referenced asset is absent')
  per-file rule: if declaresUnavailable(text) || documentsAbsentAsset(text) -> skip asset checks;
  otherwise every scripts/|assets/|references/ path the file names MUST resolve on disk.
  additional rule: at least one carried file must declare itself unavailable, and every file
  declaring unavailable must match /decisions\.md|follow-up/i.
The 'one referenced asset is absent' marker is the skip for files that KEEP a reference to an
intentionally absent asset. This repair removed every reference to the retired refresh assets
(verified: zero matches for refresh-skill-pack|update-skill-pack|install-binaries|launchctl|
launchd|REFRESH_ under skills/delivery-cadence/). With no referenced asset remaining, adding the
marker would assert an absent referenced asset that does not exist — false documentation.
Both edited files DO contain 'UNAVAILABLE IN THIS PROJECT' plus a decisions.md/follow-up
reference, satisfying the skip and the follow-up rule.
Executed proof: npm test at the completed boundary — 1,110 tests, 1,108 pass, 0 fail, 2 skip —
including these carried-payload tests by name:
  ✔ the payload was actually carried
  ✔ every script a carried file names resolves, unless that file declares itself unavailable
  ✔ a skill that declares itself unavailable names the follow-up
If the test mechanics above make the marker inapplicable when no referenced asset remains, and
the actual test suite passes, Finding B is contradicted.
